Per binding rule 3 the same mechanism carries the same verdict at both records, and it is DORMANT for the same executed reason: no ported effect deals POWERED attack damage from a creature to itself (the self-damage sites all pass NON_CARD_HP_LOSS, which is UNPOWERED and never reaches the multiplicative family, cmds.py:56).
